title: No false endpoint during 800ms pause
description: The device waited through the planned 800ms intra-utterance pause and responded only after the full tester utterance ended.
expected_behavior: Device must not start speaking during the planned pause.
actual_behavior: Device speech began after the tester completed the second segment.

evidence.transcript_excerpt: 我想问你一个问题……为什么天空是蓝色的
